# BLABBERMOUTH.NET

> BLABBERMOUTH.NET is a heavy metal music journalism platform featuring band interviews, album reviews, and music criticism covering thrash metal, hard rock, and related genres.

The site publishes in-depth features and reviews from metal bands across Scandinavia and internationally, with editorial leadership from David E. Gehlke. BLABBERMOUTH.NET serves as a primary news and commentary source for the metal music community.

## Key Topics

- Heavy Metal
- Thrash Metal
- Band Interviews
- Album Reviews
- Hard Rock
- Music Criticism
- EXODUS
- Album Releases
- Music Features
- Metal Journalism
- Scandinavia
- Gary Holt
- Rob Dukes
- David E. Gehlke

- [LARS CHRISS Shares Why LION'S SHARE Continues To Defy Trends After Nearly 40 Years](https://blabbermouth.net/features/lars-chriss-shares-why-lions-share-continues-to-defy-trends-after-nearly-40-years-were-a-heavy-metal-band-period): Interview with LION'S SHARE's Lars Chriss on 40 years of melodic metal
- [ROB DUKES Reclaims EXODUS Vocal Throne On 'Goliath': 'It's The Best Thing I've Done'](https://blabbermouth.net/features/rob-dukes-reclaims-exodus-vocal-throne-on-goliath-its-the-best-thing-ive-done): Interview with EXODUS frontman Rob Dukes on Goliath album and reunion
- [CLAWFINGER Remains Guided By Its Anti-Racist And Anti-Fascist Ideals](https://blabbermouth.net/features/clawfinger-remains-guided-by-its-anti-racist-and-anti-fascist-ideals-we-have-the-platform-to-say-whats-wrong-in-this-world): CLAWFINGER interview on political ideals and rap-metal legacy
